title: Buy information through affordable experiments
text: The Commoncog note describes effectual reasoning: begin with available means, take an affordable action, learn from it and adjust as partners or constraints become clearer. This supports a pilot designed to answer a decision-relevant question rather than one expected to validate an already fixed plan.
qualification: Secondary research synthesis. The acceptable loss must be chosen locally; the approach does not justify imposing unbounded risks on customers or workers.
